name: fcdo-travel-map
what_it_holds: A visualization/map front-end over FCDO travel advice data ('a map of all FCDO travel advice'), updated 2026-09-13. Likely pulls the same underlying FCDO source as the repo above but may have its own data snapshot committed.
why_useful: Second, independently-built FCDO client; worth checking for a committed data snapshot if the gavinmorrison repo's method needs cross-validation.
themes: Insurance, safety and travel advisories datasets (State Dept advisories history, travel insurance claims, crime by city) as demand shocks

name: predicthq/sdk-js
what_it_holds: JavaScript/Node client (MIT, 8 stars, updated Jan 2026) for the same PredictHQ Events API described above (conferences, expos, festivals, concerts, sports, holidays, severe weather).
why_useful: Same PredictHQ event/MICE calendar access as the Python SDK, for teams preferring a JS pipeline; same paid-tier caveat.
duplicate_of_holding: duplicate of predicthq/sdk-py's data source, different language binding
themes: Corporate travel and business-travel data (GBTA, Concur/SAP, Navan public indices, conference calendars), MICE datasets
why_all: Same PredictHQ event/MICE calendar access as the Python SDK, for teams preferring a JS pipeline; same paid-tier caveat.

name: predicthq/api-specs
what_it_holds: OpenAPI specification files (MIT) enumerating the full PredictHQ API schema, including the 'conferences' and 'expos' event categories, field definitions, and rank/attendance fields.
why_useful: Confirms exactly which MICE-relevant fields (conference/expo category, predicted attendance, phq-rank) are queryable via PredictHQ before committing to build a pull -- useful as a schema reference, not itself a dataset.
themes: Corporate travel and business-travel data (GBTA, Concur/SAP, Navan public indices, conference calendars), MICE datasets
why_all: Confirms exactly which MICE-relevant fields (conference/expo category, predicted attendance, phq-rank) are queryable via PredictHQ before committing to build a pull -- useful as a schema reference, not itself a dataset.

name: carlclabot96-ux/skywatch
what_it_holds: Small personal repo describing a 'real-time private jet tracker using ADS-B data'. No stars, unclear if data is committed vs. just a live tracker script; likely thin/individual project.
why_useful: Private/business-jet ADS-B tracking is a plausible high-end corporate-travel volume proxy (business jet movements as a leading indicator of executive/corporate travel intensity), a category with essentially no other GitHub presence found in this sweep. Flagged for the idea, not for this specific repo's maturity.

name: pipeworx-io/mcp-predicthq
what_it_holds: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server wrapping the PredictHQ Events API for use inside an LLM agent workflow — same underlying event categories as above (conferences, concerts, sports, community, school holidays).
why_useful: A ready client if the team ever gets a PredictHQ key; would let an agent query event density/impact by city and date range for the events/shocks gap.
